host_interfaces: existing host policy and runtime owner
entrypoint_profile: recipe C Python regular-package console binding, single request or bounded task loop, with host-specific test

supported_targets.qualification: catalog materialization only; installed host delivery pending separate validation

dependency_format: reviewed requirements.lock when host lifecycle is selected; otherwise declared evaluator dependency
configuration_format: reviewed JSON with jev_runtime.mode=off when host lifecycle is selected
secret_references: env:NAME references only; no secret values
runtime_ownership: existing host-owned runtime and task identity; generated feature flag off
legal_decisions: source-reviewed finite registry and Choice labels in implementation specification
fallback: source-reviewed baseline or block from implementation specification
verification_schedule: implementation-spec.verification, independently reviewed and not executed by materialization
